post_hoc.item: repair pass 2026-10-06: financing spread corrected from the predeclared 0.75% to the IBKR card, blended by tier at each book's own loan size (over DTB3 4.01%)
post_hoc.why: the predeclared label read 'IBKR Pro tier $1M-$50M BM+0.75%, recalled, not opened' and applied 0.75% over rf. The card was fetched in-session (ibkr_margin.html): 4.630% for $1M-50M = BM 3.88% + 0.75% = DTB3 + 0.62%; 5.380% / 4.880% for the first $100k / next $900k. A correction of a mis-sourced input, not tuning. Only books that borrow are affected (ALT-2 at ~2.1x: ~$19.6M loan, blend DTB3 + ~0.64%; ALT-1 scaled to 15%: small loan, blend ~DTB3 + 0.96%).
